key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.item: Factory Front Axle Hydraulic Lift System
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.community_sentiment: Non-negotiable requirement for 94% of buyers. Cars without lift suffer immediate 8-12% resale hit ($10,000 - $14,000 USD penalty).
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.forum_advice: Check pump fluid level in front luggage bay and cycle lift 5 times consecutively while hot to test pressure switch.

key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.item: Carbon Ceramic Brake (CCB) Rotor Weight vs Pad Visuals
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.community_sentiment: Visual pad thickness is misleading. Discs degrade by internal carbon oxidation under high heat.
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.forum_advice: Require the seller or dealer to weigh each rotor (minimum grams stamped on rotor hat). Replacing all 4 CCB rotors costs $24,000 - $30,000.

key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.community_sentiment: Aventador 7-Speed ISR and Gallardo E-Gear must have official Leonardo/LARA/ODIS clutch snap and wear readings.
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.forum_advice: If remaining clutch life is under 30% on ISR or under 20% on E-Gear, demand a $12,000 - $18,000 cash discount or walk away.

key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.item: ECU Launch Control / Thrust Mode Telemetry
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.community_sentiment: Excessive launch counts (>15-20) indicate high track duty, rear differential stress, and premature driveshaft wear.
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.forum_advice: Inspect ECU non-volatile memory via factory diagnostic scan for launch counters and over-rev histograms.

key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.item: Battery Tender Discipline & Parasitic Voltage Drain
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.community_sentiment: Supercars sitting without a maintainer for >7 days trigger voltage drop cascades, causing fake ABS, ESC, and transmission warning codes.
key_buyer_consensus_and_demands.forum_advice: Verify original CTEK/Lamborghini OEM trickle charger is included ($600 replacement value) and test resting battery CCA.

huracan_family.forum_reputation: Widely praised as the most mechanically bulletproof modern supercar due to Audi V10 and 7-speed dual-clutch (LDF) architecture.
chronic_discussion_topics: MagneRide Shock Fluid Seepage: Factory magnetic dampers weep fluid past seals; replacement costs $8,500 - $12,000 for all 4 corners.
Front Axle Lift Solenoid & Pump Seal: Lift failure warning light; pump rebuild $2,800, OEM complete unit $6,500.
Thermostat Housing & Coolant Valley Seam: Micro-fractures in plastic coolant junction tubes cause sweet smell and slow coolant loss ($2,200).
Early Infotainment Cluster Freeze (2015-2017): Black screen on startup; dealer software re-flash needed via ODIS ($800 - $1,500).
huracan_family.buyer_negotiation_rules: Always deduct $10,000 if Front Lift is absent. Deduct $8,000 if MagneRide shocks show grease/fluid mist.

aventador_family.forum_reputation: Raw, visceral 6.5L naturally aspirated V12 icon, but ISR 7-speed single-clutch transmission demands specialized driving habits and high reserve fund.
chronic_discussion_topics: ISR Concentric Slave Cylinder / Release Bearing Failure: Hydraulic seals degrade, leaking fluid inside bellhousing; causes violent shudder or stuck in neutral. Requires complete transmission drop ($14,000 - $18,000).
Horizontal Pushrod Rear Suspension Bushings: Bushings develop play after 12,000 miles, creating clunks under hard cornering ($5,500).
Safety Recall L616 EVAP Purge Canister: Overfilling fuel tank causes vapor canister saturation and fire hazard during high-rev exhaust overrun. Must verify recall completion.
Oil Cooler Return Hose O-Rings: Located in rear passenger wheel well; leaks oil near hot headers ($3,800).
aventador_family.buyer_negotiation_rules: Never purchase an Aventador without documented clutch wear readout. If wear exceeds 65%, demand $15,000 price cut.

urus_family.forum_reputation: Unrivaled daily utility and ferocious acceleration, but high-weight vehicle with heavy wear on tires, carbon ceramic brakes, and turbo plumbing.
chronic_discussion_topics: Hot-V Turbo Valley Coolant O-Rings: 4.0L Twin-Turbo V8 generates intense engine valley heat, causing plastic Y-pipes and turbo coolant O-rings to leak ($3,400).
Air Suspension Compressor & Valve Block Sag: Vehicle slumps to one corner overnight due to valve block solenoid leaks ($4,200).
Parasitic Battery Drain: 48-volt active roll stabilization system can drain standard 12V AGM battery if parked for >10 days without tender.
23-inch P-Zero Tire Consumption: Inner shoulder camber wear requires replacement every 8,000 - 10,000 miles ($2,800 per set).
urus_family.buyer_negotiation_rules: Verify Bang & Olufsen 3D Advanced Sound ($7,000 option) and 23-inch Taigete wheels; base audio hurts resale.

revuelto_and_temerario.forum_reputation: Next-generation HPEV hybrids. Unprecedented demand with 2.5-year factory order backlogs. Tech complexity is highest in supercar history.
chronic_discussion_topics: Revuelto Scissor Door Gas Strut Retaining Pin: Subject to official NHTSA safety recall 25V477000; loose pins allow 100-pound doors to drop unexpectedly.
Oil Circuit Flange Screws (NHTSA 24V945000): Radiator to oil tank connection torque verification required to prevent leaks.
Rearview Camera Software Glitch (NHTSA 26V053000): Backup camera screen blackout; resolved by dealer OTA firmware flash.
Temerario Alleggerita Carbon Lightweight Package: Forum debate over $45,000 weight-reduction package vs street usability.
revuelto_and_temerario.buyer_negotiation_rules: Immediate verification that all factory safety recall campaigns are signed off in Lamborghini Unica app.

gallardo_and_murcielago.forum_reputation: Modern classics experiencing explosive appreciation, especially gated 6-speed manuals (commanding 100-150% premium over E-Gear).
chronic_discussion_topics: Gallardo E-Gear Actuator Solenoids: Hydraulic block failure ($8,000) or clutch snap reading <20% ($9,500 replacement).
Gallardo Rear Bumper Heat Deformation: Aftermarket or uncatted exhausts without heat shielding melt rear bumper near taillights ($4,500).
Murcielago Rear Main Crank Seal: Oil weeps directly onto clutch disc, causing slippage on full throttle ($12,000 engine-out service).
Murcielago Active Aero Batwing Flaps: Jammed motorized air scoops fail to deploy at 75 mph ($3,200 motor replacement).
gallardo_and_murcielago.buyer_negotiation_rules: Factor in mandatory $15,000 reserve fund for Murcielago engine-out clutch/seal service before making offer.
